```{r}
options(rstudio.help.showDataPreview = FALSE)
rm(list = ls())

pkg_list <- c("fmsb", "packcircles", "pander", "readxl", "visreg", "EnvStats", "factoextra", "data.table",
              "reticulate", "xml2", "tidyverse", "plyr", "deldir", "viridis", "Hmisc", "devtools", "ggplot2",
              "gridExtra", "dplyr", "cowplot", "stats", "emmeans", "corrplot", "sf", "SciViews")

for(pkg in pkg_list){
  library(pkg, character.only = T)
}
```

```{r}
CellSet_full <- read.csv("CellSet/CellSet_full.csv")
anatomy2 <- read.csv("Data/Anatomy/anatomy2.csv")

test_CS <- CellSet_full %>% filter(CS_id == "B04_B_To_C01_Z20_01")

CellSet_plot <- ggplot(CellSet_full) +
  geom_polygon(aes(x = x, y = y, group = id_cell, fill = type), color = "white") +
  coord_fixed() +
  facet_wrap(~CS_id)

ggsave(filename = "plots/CellSet.png", plot = CellSet_plot,device = "png", width = 20, height = 15, dpi = 300, units = "in")
```
